data.name: Aarifah
data.gender_notes: Aarifah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aarifah is an elegant Arabic name for girls, meaning 'knowledgeable' or 'wise'. It reflects a deep spiritual understanding and calm demeanor. Girls named Aarifah are seen as intuitive, reflective, and insightful thinkers. The name Aarifah carries the meaning “Knowledgeable, Wise Woman” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Aarifah usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledgeable, wise woman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents someone connected to higher wisdom and divine truth, guiding others with patience and knowledge.
data.etymology: Aarifah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledgeable, Wise Woman.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aarifah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: عارفہ
in_arabic.long_meaning: عارفہ: مصدر عرف، يَعرِفُ، يعرف، يُدرك، إدراك، علم، معرفة، تخصص. تنسب إلى علم الدين الحراني الحنفي، كان من عارفين الدين. يُستخدم اسم عارِفة في القرآن الكريم. إسم عارِفة من أسماء الصالحين، يُعتبر إسمًا من الأسماء الخيرة، يُشير إلى من يُدرك الحق، ويَعرف الله عز وجل. يُعتبر إسمًا من الأسماء التي تأتي من جذر عرف، ويُستخدم للإشارة إلى علم الدين، ويُشير إلى من يُعرف الله عز وجل، ويَعرف الحق.

in_urdu.name: عارفہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عارفہ: اس کا مطلب ہے تخصص، علم، معارف، ادراک، معرفت، علم دین اور عرفیت ہے۔ اس کا نام دین الحرانی ہے جو ایک عارف بزرگ تھے۔ Quran میں ان کا نام آ گیا ہے۔ عارفہ نام ایک صالح نام ہے جو ایک صالح اور بہتر نام ہے۔ یہ نام علم دین کے لئے مخصوص ہے۔

in_hindi.name: आरिफ़ा
in_hindi.long_meaning: आरिफ़ा: इसका अर्थ है विशेषज्ञता, ज्ञान, जानकारी, विचार, और गहरी समझ। मूल रूप से यह नाम अरबी और फ़ारसी भाषा से आया है। इस नाम का संबंध एक श्रेष्ठ विद्वान, श्री इब्ने इलियास से है। यह नाम एक सुंदर और पवित्र नाम है, जो न्याय और ज्ञान का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: عارفہ
in_pashto.long_meaning: عارفہ: دغه یې پوهنه، وېشلوک، دلوارېدل، پوهيدل اور وېشلوک اېدل دي. دغه نوم د دین الحرانی په نوم اساس دی چې یو عارف دی. قرآن کریم کې دغه نوم راټول شوی دی. عارفہ یو نوم دی چې د صلحو څخه راتله دی، دغه نوم عطا شوی دی او د دین په نوم راټول شوی دی.

in_english.name: Aarifah
in_english.long_meaning: Aarifah: A name that conveys knowledge, expertise, understanding, and comprehension. It is derived from the Arabic root 'arafa', which means to know, understand, and recognize. In Islamic tradition, Aarifah is a name associated with scholars and knowledgeable individuals. It is a name that symbolizes wisdom, intelligence, and spiritual growth.

data.cultural_impact: The Arabic name "Aarifah" carries a rich cultural significance, especially in the Islamic world. It signifies a strong emphasis on knowledge and education for girls. The naming of a girl as Aarifah is often seen as a recognition and encouragement of the inherent intellectual abilities that all individuals possess, especially among Muslim communities. Moreover, this name aligns with various Islamic teachings that encourage knowledge, curiosity, and critical thinking.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Aarifah" signifies a deep sense of wisdom and knowledge in the spiritual realm. In Islamic tradition, the term "Arafah" is used to refer to the day during the annual Hajj pilgrimage when pilgrims stand in a plain named Arafat. This event represents the day of accounting, when individuals seek Allah's forgiveness, repent for their sins, and purify their souls.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Aarifah signifies one who possesses knowledge and understanding, a seeker of wisdom and truth. It also symbolizes the journey of self-discovery and enlightenment, as one deepens their connection with the Divine.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Aarifah bint Abdul-Mutalib was the sister of Prophet Muhammad. The name Aarifah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: She is mentioned in various Hadiths and Sira literature.
